findings.body: Raise: Not done. New evidence beyond the accepted doctor finding: `forge doctor` uses the build worker to choose the source of `models.grill` (doctor.py:434), but plan reads choose their reader independently (story.py:226–227). In a two-tool repo with `workers = "codex"` and only `[models.grill.claude]` in `forge.local.toml`, a plan read from Codex uses Claude's local model while doctor reports `models.grill` as a built-in default. This misstates a model source the Done-when requires doctor to show; the named proof tests only build and fix model sources.

why: Developers on one team have different agent access, but who builds and which models live in the committed forge.toml, so one developer's switch to Codex lands in pull requests and flips teammates' settings
